goog.module('genericmethod.Subject$impl');

const BaseSubject = goog.require('genericmethod.BaseSubject$impl');
const Publisher = goog.require('genericmethod.Publisher$impl');
const $Util = goog.require('nativebootstrap.Util$impl');

/**
 * @interface
 * @template V
 * @extends {Publisher<V>}
 * @extends {BaseSubject<V>}
 */
class Subject {
 /** @nodts */
 static $clinit() {
  Subject.$clinit = () =>{};
  Subject.$loadModules();
  Publisher.$clinit();
 }
 
 static $markImplementor(/** Function */ ctor) {
  Publisher.$markImplementor(ctor);
  BaseSubject.$markImplementor(ctor);
  ctor.prototype.$implements__genericmethod_Subject = true;
 }
 /** @nodts @return {boolean} */
 static $isInstance(/** ? */ instance) {
  return instance != null && !!instance.$implements__genericmethod_Subject;
 }
 
 /** @nodts */
 static $loadModules() {}
}
Subject.$markImplementor(/**@type {Function}*/ (Subject));
$Util.$setClassMetadataForInterface(/**@type {Function}*/ (Subject), 'genericmethod.Subject');
